1371725689.annotation: A good item to buy the enemies are playing outside of Warp Stone+Dash Range constantly

1250307611.annotation: Great item versus certain heros, like Haze, Infernus, Wraith, and Mirage. I sometimes delay Scourage to buy this sooner depending on the enemy team.

1662311306.annotation: Counter item to build versus Pocket and Wraith, but generally a good item even without a specific counter

865958998.annotation: VERY GOOD ITEM IF YOU GET USED TO USING IT

1644605047.annotation: Can be a life saver vs quick stuns such as Abrams Charge, not incredibly needed vs Bebop since you can use burrow after being hooked anyways

3140772621.annotation: Buy when needed, can buy at any point in the game. Generally bullet resist is less needed than spirit resist because of burrow. But if you are getting pulled out of burrow consistently may be needed.

2820116164.annotation: An item to buy if you are weaker and want your ults to be better. Cheaper, but worse, than getting Unstoppable and Cheat Death

2447176615.annotation: Can buy this sooner if vs many slows (Kelvin, Viscous, etc.) Or if it helps you secure Unsecured Souls before a fight

3005970438.annotation: Gives damage to whole team, and a little resist.

3585132399.annotation: Still good some games while ahead, allows you to stay on map and continue pressuring. Not great when behind since you are more likely to be close to base anyways

1254091416.annotation: Very good item versus most heros, but Grey Talon, Lash, and Vindicta especially

3144988365.annotation: Newly buffed and does a very large amount of damage, though slowly. It is also the best anti-heal other than Spirit Burn

619484391.annotation: Tempo Spirit Sap into mid game Silence Wave may be strong now

343572757.annotation: Buy this if you are hyper carrying the game
